The Market Explosion story
I was probably 6 or 8 bars away from the explosion. I heard the explosion and somebody, as i was running down somebody in English said bicycle bomb. There were no Americans hurt. I tried to stop the bleeding of a women by compressing the blood in and then someone else took over of Vietnamese. It was horrific, women and children were hurt bad. I didn't see any men there. There were 3 or 4 Americans running down with me, I didn't know any of them.
